decisions.rationale: Candidate authorizes auditors although the specification permits only administrators or owners; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, casefold is equivalent to lowercase and surrounding whitespace remains trimmed; the suite passes.
Non-empty behavior satisfies the specification and tests pass, but empty behavior changed from returning None to raising ValueError while the specification explicitly leaves it unspecified.
Malformed and out-of-range ports now return 0 instead of raising ConfigError; the malformed-input test fails.
With ordered bounds, the median of low, value, and high is exactly the inclusive clamp result; the suite passes.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the total test fails.
Candidate uses case-sensitive default sorting rather than case-insensitive sorting; the ordering test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, contrary to the inclusive-boundary requirement; the boundary test fails.
Production behavior still returns true for True, but the candidate test incorrectly expects false and the required candidate suite fails.

strategy_summary: Compared each exact base-to-candidate diff with its public specification and executed all three permitted commands per fixture. Selected all determinate outcomes and withheld the claim whose empty-sequence intent is unspecified.
